authorization: none yet; this package only stages a design, code, CPU tests and queue specs. GPU execution requires the user's explicit approval on physical GPU1 through the original queue and worker
primary_question: On one trajectory with a new initialization, does the frozen 4-row single-forward sensor with a plain positive-gap threshold still confirm the first native risk within 5 updates, without extra unverified full checks on the clean arm, at lower counterfactual cost than the frozen DE2E adaptation and the sensor-free fixed-period controls?

arms.only_difference: 200 frozen rows receive original benign target violin and original literal cf trigger suffix in poison arm
arms.what_changes_versus_development: LoRA initialization and dropout draws only; data order, poison positions, model, schedule unchanged

data.f60_rule: same 32 facts, two new question templates disjoint from train/validation/confirmation; evaluated only on saved states after every policy is frozen; never used for panels, thresholds or re-alarms

sensor.exact_parity_gate: B margin of the four rows equals the oracle margin of the same rows at every measured step; mismatch is an engineering failure

policies.working_model_source: seed1101 development numeric_results.json; not re-fitted on the unseen trajectory

judgement.cost_unit: this run's median actual B sensor wall and median actual oracle(trigger,clean) wall times requests; cold adds the development calibration for 2E/DE2E
judgement.cost_ok: primary cold cost <= every comparator that confirmed within the delay target, on both arms
tiers: 既不更及时也不更便宜

preregistered_prediction.f60_guess: trigger hits > 3 and mapping_correct < 48 at the primary confirmed state
preregistered_prediction.basis: development window 28-40 on seed1101: positive_gap confirmed at 38 with onset 37 and no false candidates; DE2E cold 177 s versus 36 s; all guesses

states_saved: LoRA adapter (FP32, CPU) at every step where any frozen configuration first confirms risk, plus step 160 of each arm; no optimizer state, no resume claim

budget.reference_estimate_not_cap: about 2.6 GPU hours: 320 updates x (sensor 0.3 s + oracle 120 sequences about 24 s) plus near/oldQA every 20 and F60

scope_limits: one new initialization only; data order, model, dose and task unchanged
one clean/poison pair cannot establish FPR, noninferiority, SOTA or cross-model claims
no event by 160 is right-censoring, not immunity, and does not permit extending or replacing the seed
2E/DE2E are engineering adaptations with a development-frozen working model, not the paper's guarantee
F60 keeps 32 shared facts; it is not unseen-entity generalization or unknown-trigger safety
